sources.title: Contrastive Learning Guide | AI Understanding
sources.snippet: Contrastive learning teaches a model to pull similar things together and push dissimilar things apart in an embedding space. It matters because it lets AI learn powerful representations from mostly unlabeled data, powering image search, recommendations, and multimodal models. What is the core objective of contrastive learning?
